$comment: Interlocks from the operator policy's control.preconditions, driven through BOTH runtimes: tests/unit/test_preconditions.py and packages/server-node/test/preconditions.test.mjs call checkPreconditions / check_preconditions on each `input` and assert `expect` — null when every requirement holds, else the exact refusal for the first that does not. `current` maps each requirement node, as written, to what reading it returned: a Good value, a Bad status, or null when the entry did not resolve to a node. A requirement holds only on a Good value; numbers in the sentence are written as format_number writes them and everything else as JSON.stringify would.

cases.name: equals true, and it is false
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=110 equals true; ns=2;i=110 is false now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: equals a string
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=19 equals "AUTO"; ns=2;i=19 is "MANUAL" now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: true is not 1
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=41 equals true; ns=2;i=41 is 1 now. Nothing was sent.

in a set, and it is not
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=19 is one of "AUTO", "MANUAL"; ns=2;i=19 is "STOP" now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: between, and it is above
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=3 is between 0 and 80; ns=2;i=3 is 90 now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: at least
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=3 is at least 10; ns=2;i=3 is 5 now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: at most, with a fraction

cases.name: a numeric bound on a string is not met
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=19 is at least 0; ns=2;i=19 is "abc" now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: a node that did not resolve is not met
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while /Objects/Nowhere equals true; /Objects/Nowhere is unresolvable now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: the first requirement that fails is the one reported
cases.expect: The operator policy allows changing ns=2;i=111 only while ns=2;i=3 is at most 80; ns=2;i=3 is 81 now. Nothing was sent.

cases.name: a method target

cases.name: non-ASCII text is echoed as written
